detailed_descriptions.en: Indie Game × Indie Music Music is at the heart of Beat For Speed and we believe great music deserves to find its audience. We're excited to bring you songs from independent artists and labels, including Epidemic Sound, Kitty Ray, Sunday Cruise and The Pom-Poms through Lauren Records, alongside indie rock band tears please and more. Experience their music through handcrafted rhythm levels, and discover your next favorite artist along the way. 🐱 A Special Gift for Early Riders! Purchase Beat For Speed and launch the game for the first time within the first 14 days after release to receive 1 of 6 randomly selected kitties as your little riding buddy! Turn Any Song Into a High-Speed Rhythm Ride Import your favorite songs and transform them into playable racing experiences. Beat For Speed is a rhythm game where every beat becoms a challenge. Ride through dynamic tracks generated from your songs, from genres like Pop, K-Pop to Hip-Hop, Rock, EDM and more. Every song becomes a brand new ride. Play Your Music, Ride in Real Time! With Live Audio Mode , music playing on your PC becomes a rhythm ride in real time. Open your favorite music app or browser player, put on a playlist and start riding. No song import needed. Prefer local files? You can also import your favorite songs and turn them into playable tracks. We spent countless hours creating thousands of handcrafted levels and built our own system based on that experience. Designed to recognize musical structures, rhythmic patterns and energy changes across different music genres, it transforms your songs into unique tracks. Create, Share and Discover Endless Community Content With full Steam Workshop support, explore a growing library of community-created experiences or create your own. It never ends. Steam Workshop & Editor Massive Custom Levels: Discover custom tracks created by players worldwide in Steam Workshop. Custom Protagonist Models: Personalize your experience by importing unique character models. Level Editor: Use our built-in Level Editor to manually craft rhythm masterpieces with frame-perfect precision. Share your creations with the community! Climb the Leaderboards See how high you can score and compete with players all over the world. Whether you're climbing the rankings or beating your personal best, there's always another reason to ride again. Find Your Flow Through Music Every lane shift, collision, and dodge movement is synchronized with the rhythm. Put on something fast and test your reflexes, or pick something mellow and enjoy the scenery. Ride through cities, forests, coastlines and snowy mountains, with different weather and skies to match your mood. Put on your favorite song. Let’s ride.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Indie Game × Indie Music

Music is at the heart of Beat For Speed and we believe great music deserves to find its audience. We're excited to bring you songs from independent artists and labels, including Epidemic Sound, Kitty Ray, Sunday Cruise and The Pom-Poms through Lauren Records, alongside indie rock band tears please and more.

Experience their music through handcrafted rhythm levels, and discover your next favorite artist along the way.

🐱 A Special Gift for Early Riders!

Purchase Beat For Speed and launch the game for the first time within the first 14 days after release to receive 1 of 6 randomly selected kitties as your little riding buddy!

Turn Any Song Into a High-Speed Rhythm Ride

Import your favorite songs and transform them into playable racing experiences.

Beat For Speed is a rhythm game where every beat becoms a challenge. Ride through dynamic tracks generated from your songs, from genres like Pop, K-Pop to Hip-Hop, Rock, EDM and more. Every song becomes a brand new ride.

Play Your Music, Ride in Real Time!

With Live Audio Mode, music playing on your PC becomes a rhythm ride in real time. Open your favorite music app or browser player, put on a playlist and start riding. No song import needed.

Prefer local files? You can also import your favorite songs and turn them into playable tracks.

We spent countless hours creating thousands of handcrafted levels and built our own system based on that experience. Designed to recognize musical structures, rhythmic patterns and energy changes across different music genres, it transforms your songs into unique tracks. 

Create, Share and Discover Endless Community Content 

With full Steam Workshop support, explore a growing library of community-created experiences or create your own. It never ends.

Steam Workshop & Editor

  • Massive Custom Levels: Discover custom tracks created by players worldwide in Steam Workshop.

  • Custom Protagonist Models: Personalize your experience by importing unique character models.

  • Level Editor: Use our built-in Level Editor to manually craft rhythm masterpieces with frame-perfect precision.

    Share your creations with the community!

Climb the Leaderboards

See how high you can score and compete with players all over the world. Whether you're climbing the rankings or beating your personal best, there's always another reason to ride again.

Find Your Flow Through Music

Every lane shift, collision, and dodge movement is synchronized with the rhythm. Put on something fast and test your reflexes, or pick something mellow and enjoy the scenery. Ride through cities, forests, coastlines and snowy mountains, with different weather and skies to match your mood.

Put on your favorite song. Let’s ride.
